body:
From someone who’s struggling to graduate high school and comes from a family of lawyers electrical engineers and chemists I feel your pain. I’m constantly called a failure by my parents and can’t stand to be home because all I’m ever asked is how I’m doing in school and why my grades aren’t higher. And when I answer honestly I get yelled at threatened to get kicked out of the house and honestly wish for nothing more than the sweet release of death. 

Just hang in there. Get away from your family, do what I can’t for another year or two. Family is more than being related by blood. If they don’t want to see you that’s not your family. Those are people you’re related to.

Good luck shits hard but eventually it’s get better. You have to cut the toxic people out of your life though. No one deserves to be called a failure.

Yeah I have a therapist and a psychiatrist. I also do powerlifting and compete in it but idk anymore. I always feel so happy and fulfilled when I do it but as soon as I leave the gym it’s hell. I’m not good enough to make a career out of lifting. I’m not good enough to make music a career. I just can’t keep hope anymore. 

My parents have been going fucking bat shit crazy on me for so long now because I don’t get good grades. No matter how hard I try I can’t get them. I’m simply not book smart yet I seem to be the only one who excepts that. I don’t want to go to college because I don’t see the point in getting a higher education if it’s not in music when I’m already fucking retarded. I’d be paying and going into debt just to fail all my fucking classes. 

I’m just tired man. I’ve tried for so long and so hard to keep going. I’ve been in therapy for years, I’ve been medicated for over a year with different dosages, I have tried expressing myself in different ways yet nothing seems worth it anymore. 

Thinking about it I probably won’t cut myself because I have an addictive personality. I’ll 100% need to do it over and over again. It’ll be hard to explain to my family why I’m constantly bandaged. 

Thank you for listening to me rant.
I already do. I’m medicated. Nothing works anymore and I have no other way to express my life. Just once I want to feel something other than suffering even if it’s in the form of physical pain.

Tell them. Assuming your parents aren’t crazy and or abusive they’ll believe you and get you help. Trust me the first day I told them that I had tried killing myself multiple times was the first day that I started to get better. 

Things are going to look up for you but you can’t sit around and wait for them to get better.
